Project Overview
================

A short introduction that runs on a little longer than one line would, so a reader sees how the printer treats a long line under the preserve setting.

Getting started
---------------

1. Install it.
2. Run it:

   ```
   tool --flag value
   ```

3. Read the output.

Options
-------

Option | Default | Meaning
:-- | :-: | --:
`--quiet` | off | prints nothing
`--depth` | 3 | how deep to go

* Notes:
    * one
    * two
